apps.name: Fueli
apps.subtitle: AI-powered calorie tracking
apps.versionDescription:
Nutrition review and reliability update

- Review editable meal/photo descriptions and labeled ingredient weights before choosing USDA or Open Food Facts, the free alternative compatible with the on-device architecture.
- Improve USDA bagel/cream-cheese resolution, exact barcode validation, fractional serving entry, independent Save/Log actions, and immutable historical nutrition/source snapshots.
- Improve native receipt review, deterministic abbreviation/unit cleanup, library search navigation, corrupt-backup validation, and invalid profile/workout handling.
- Add reproducible isolated UI journeys, mocked provider/network contracts, live AI/photo/USDA/Open Food Facts checks, receipt fixtures, migration/backup tests, and a fail-closed release gate.

Validation: 134 unit/rendering/live-API tests, 18 UI tests, and 4 release-gate tests passed. Zero failures or skips in the accepted app test runs. The numeric edit/history workflow also passed three consecutive iterations. Signed Release archive, Free build, and public-source-only build passed. Camera scanning and Apple Health were confirmed by the user on their device.

Bundle identifier: com.welford.fueli. Minimum iOS: 18. Personal API keys are not bundled; new installations configure them in Settings.

Commands, evidence, migration details, configuration and verification limits: https://github.com/mwelford2/Fueli/blob/main/Fueli/RIGOROUS_TEST_REPORT.md

First Fueli release using com.welford.fueli. The Release build includes HealthKit support. This IPA is unsigned; users must sign it with an explicit HealthKit-enabled App ID and a compatible provisioning profile. Changing the bundle ID makes this a separate app from the prior com.matteowelford.calclone releases.
